subject: Urgent: SOC 2 clearance matrix & bridge letter request — BluePeak procurement timeline
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@bluepeakcapital.com>, procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: SOC 2 clearance matrix & bridge letter request — BluePeak procurement timeline

Team —

BluePeak is finalizing their procurement by COB 2027-04-22 and procurement has a hard requirement for a SOC 2 Type II report covering at least the last 12 months OR a signed bridge/interim attestation that covers current controls + a documented plan to provide the Type II within 60 days. They flagged that without something formal they will pause the PO.

They also attached a short SIG excerpt (procurement cited controls mapping) — I’ve attached the excerpt they sent. They want a mapping of artifacts to control criteria (essentially a clearance matrix) and either: 1) the full Type II PDF, or 2) an executed bridge letter + DocuSign link they can send to legal.

Ask: can Security produce a bridge letter template we can get signed and a quick artifact mapping for the SIG excerpt within 48 hours? If we can’t get the signed bridge letter in that window, this $750k ARR opportunity will slip.

I’m happy to jump on a short call with procurement if it helps accelerate acceptance. 

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: BluePeak_SIG_excerpt.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@bluepeakcapital.com>, procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: SOC 2 clearance matrix & bridge letter request — BluePeak procurement timeline

Sean / team —

We can provide a signed bridge letter that summarizes our controls and references the latest SOC 2 Type II audit in principle. Two clarifications before I proceed:

1) Procurement acceptance criteria — do they require the bridge to reference a specific audit period (e.g., Jan–Dec 2026) or is a statement of current controls acceptable? Please confirm.
2) Artifact scope — to speed this up, send me a prioritized list of the specific evidence items BluePeak needs (e.g., access control lists, patching cadence reports, change management tickets). If they’ll accept the bridge first and evidence within 30–45 days, that’s a helpful path.

Operationally: I can produce a bridge letter draft in 24 hours and sign it via DocuSign within 48 hours if legal approves. For the artifact mapping, we’ll need 72–96 hours to pull reports and screenshots from ops, depending on the number of items.

If the prospect insists on the final Type II PDF, we don’t have a new Type II until the end of Q3; in that case we should push the bridge + interim attestation approach.

Laura Bennett
Security Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: SOC2_bridge_letter_draft.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: SOC 2 clearance matrix & bridge letter request — BluePeak procurement timeline

Laura — attaching the artifact matrix I assembled from BluePeak’s SIG excerpt (they called out 18 items; I prioritized 8 critical ones procurement won't waive). The attachment maps each SIG question to an artifact we can produce and a suggested owner.

Key highlights:
- Access control evidence: Okta tenant report + sample user access review (owner: IT Ops)
- Patch management: monthly vulnerability scan exports + ticketing proof (owner: Infra)
- Change control: recent change log extract + PR/incident links (owner: Eng Ops)
- Encryption at rest/in transit: KMS config snippets + cert inventories (owner: Platform Sec)

I also added a short candidate text for the bridge letter that aligns with BluePeak’s procurement language — feel free to edit. Drive link with raw evidence pointers: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-link

If we can get the signed bridge today or tomorrow, BluePeak will proceed to finalize the PO contingent on receiving the artifacts within 30 days.

Thanks —
Karthik
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: artifact_matrix_v1.csv
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@bluepeakcapital.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: SOC 2 clearance matrix & bridge letter request — BluePeak procurement timeline

Hi Sean / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement confirmed they will accept a signed bridge/interim attestation for up to 30 days provided the letter: 1) references the controls in place as of the last audit period, 2) commits to delivering Type II within 60 days, and 3) includes a named escalation contact and point of signature (DocuSign acceptable).

Confirming BluePeak needs the signed bridge by 2027-04-19 to keep the PO on track for 2027-04-22. The artifacts can follow within 30 days. Our procurement lead copied here (procurement@bluepeak.com) will route DocuSign to legal.

If you can provide the DocuSign link and the named contact, we’ll accept electronically and proceed with the PO once executed.

Best —
Sarah Lewis
Head of Vendor Risk | BluePeak Capital
sarah.lewis@bluepeakcapital.com

Attachment: (none)

Subject: Re: Urgent: SOC 2 clearance matrix & bridge letter request — BluePeak procurement timeline

Thanks all — we need to prioritize this. Laura, please finalize the bridge letter using Karthik’s candidate text and sign via DocuSign today (target signed copy to Sarah by EOD 2027-04-19). Marissa / Ops: please start pulling the top 8 artifacts Karthik prioritized; flag any item that will take >72 hours. Sean, keep procurement engaged and offer a 15-minute call if they push back.

I’ll authorize any reasonable legal minor edits to the bridge letter — escalate to me only if legal identifies material issues. This opportunity needs a fast path.

-Vivek
